=== enter between braces
--- before
fn main() {¦}
--- keys
<enter>
--- after
fn main() {
    ¦
}

=== electric closer
--- before
impl S {
    fn f() {}
    ¦
--- keys
}
--- after
impl S {
    fn f() {}
}¦

=== lifetime quote no autoclose
--- before
fn f<¦>()
--- keys
'a
--- after
fn f<'a¦>()

=== autoclose paren
--- before
let x = ¦;
--- keys
(1, 2
--- after
let x = (1, 2¦);

=== overtype
--- before
let x = ¦;
--- keys
(1)
--- after
let x = (1)¦;

=== surround
--- before
let x = «v»;
--- keys
[
--- after
let x = [«v»];

=== line comment
--- before
«let a = 1;
    let b = 2;»
--- keys
<lc>
--- after
«// let a = 1;
//     let b = 2;»

=== no autoclose in comment
--- before
// todo ¦
--- keys
(
--- after
// todo (¦

=== match arm enter
--- before
match x {¦}
--- keys
<enter>1 => 2,
--- after
match x {
    1 => 2,¦
}

=== string no pair
--- before
let s = "a¦";
--- keys
[
--- after
let s = "a[¦";
